extracted.summary: A government initiative offering financial aid to economically disadvantaged students from Andaman and Nicobar pursuing higher education beyond Class 10.
extracted.max_family_income_quote: Applicants must have a combined annual income not exceeding INR 1,00,000.
extracted.categories_quote: Applicants must be of the General category, that is not SC, ST or OBC.
extracted.states_quote: Applicants must be domiciled in Andaman and Nicobar.
